text: Introducing the methionine finger and adjacent alanine from cognate CheY6 into noncognate CheYs both switched their specificity toward CheA3 and conferred rapid phosphotransfer from CheA3-P, while mutating these same residues abolished binding and phosphotransfer [11603066], indicating that rapid phosphotransfer rates are indeed correlated with histidine kinase–response regulator specificity.
